researchDepth: Bounded planning/monitoring/control landscape, exact nine-entity review and signed external-input RDS audit. Primary abstracts and selected methods/results; not nine independent systematic reviews.

entityReviews.constructReview: Strength and accessibility of cue-linked commitment, not merely assignment to an if-then-plan condition.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Plan production, declared commitment and cue-response priming need separate measures; goal achievement is downstream.
entityReviews.timeReview: Minutes/hours of encoding versus maintained access over days/weeks; no stable-habit equivalence.
entityReviews.unresolved: Reuse F08 if-then identity HT0014; no duplicate or direct effect on strength inferred from plan instruction. Existing REL-PSY-036 proposal remains exact.

entityReviews.constructReview: Specificity of the person's action plan: what/when/where/how/resources, not external recommendation specificity.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Plan content coding differs from internal uptake; intervention-arm uptake and specificity are selected, not independently randomized.
entityReviews.timeReview: Immediate plan detail versus repeated execution over weeks; gym attendance null does not prove no plan formed.
entityReviews.unresolved: No signed effect from external recommendations or guided plan-generation without exact comparator and internal-plan measurement.

entityReviews.constructReview: Frequency and attentional intensity of observing/comparing own behavior or progress with a goal, not passive tracking availability.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Recording frequency is one operational facet; attention/comparison, target stability, reactivity and reporting distinguish actual monitoring from sensor collection.
entityReviews.timeReview: Checks occur hours/days; goal attainment and calculated discrepancy updates can follow through different paths.
entityReviews.unresolved: Prompt/check candidate EA0016 remains RN pending exact protocol, comparator and monitoring-versus-recording alignment; no automatic gap reduction.

entityReviews.constructReview: Signed perceived reference-minus-current difference; RDS, not primitive motivation or directly manipulated capacity.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Two required external inputs, same person/goal/window/units. Neither input has a canonical constituent Driver ID; formula and sign are not inferred from outcome scales.
entityReviews.timeReview: Recalculate after input/reference/window changes. Monitoring may reveal discrepancy immediately; later action changes perceived current state.
entityReviews.unresolved: HEIGHTENED incoming REL-PSY-037 requires split review: revealing gap versus later corrective action. Toward zero is not universal numeric decrease; no RDS effect target.

entityReviews.constructReview: Currently available ability to regulate intensity, duration, expression or consequences to a goal; not habitual strategy preference.
entityReviews.measurementReview: ERSQ past-week skills profile and observed expression are not instantaneous latent capacity. ART package contains several skills; common-factor comparator matters.
entityReviews.timeReview: Skills acquisition across weeks versus deployment now; emotion reduction not universal goal or capacity evidence.
entityReviews.unresolved: ART waitlist advantage and active-comparator nondetection preserved; no atomic reappraisal efficacy from package, no new effect or mediation record.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current goal-directed attention control despite interference; distinguish allocation, WM availability and trait self-report.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Executive tasks carry speed/accuracy, strategy and motivation components. Anxiety may lower efficiency without lowering final accuracy.
entityReviews.timeReview: Momentary fatigue versus trained skill and trait; no duration/magnitude inferred from RDoC framework.
entityReviews.unresolved: BIO-019 needs exact fatigue-to-control evidence. F06 protective-control polarity concern retained; no RDS or task-score shortcut.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current ability to stop/suppress prepotent or initiated response; not consumption, go speed or self-reported restraint.
entityReviews.measurementReview: GNG withholding and SST stopping differ; go RT, Stroop interference, WM and inhibitory capacity cannot be pooled as semantic identity.
entityReviews.timeReview: Immediate task gains versus transfer and four-month followup; sleep protocols not enduring trait changes.
entityReviews.unresolved: EA0017 remains RN. Review pooled heterogeneous cognitive measures; Enge active-control null versus passive-control latency improvement must not disappear.

entityReviews.constructReview: Current goal-aligned control under impulse/conflict, not stable conscientiousness, moral worth or a proven depletable substance.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Task/questionnaire convergence heterogeneous; executive-task measures weaker than informant reports. SRC157 stored PMID wrong; exact intended work verified separately.
entityReviews.timeReview: Sequential short tasks do not establish universal finite-resource depletion; training literature does not prove permanent trait change.
entityReviews.unresolved: Large replication outcomes differ. Preserve confirmatory nondetection and small positive task-specific result; no universal depletion edge or capacity-increase claim.

entityReviews.constructReview: Adaptive selection/revision of coping to demands/controllability/feedback, not repertoire size alone or cognitive switching.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Fit, perceived ability and variation operationalizations differ; country differences and self-report adjustment associations not causal culture or clinical benefit.
entityReviews.timeReview: Within-situation adaptation versus training across weeks; performance and retrospective repertoire not instantaneous flexibility.
entityReviews.unresolved: Chinese workplace serious-play/CBT packages and coping-fit synthesis remain RN for exact Driver; discriminative-thinking mediation not identified.

existingReviews.rationale: Fatigue could impair goal-directed control, but cited framework/remediation sources do not isolate exact BIO-026 state from subjective effort, task exposure or PSY-080 performance.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Task-sequence replications differ; increased effort can compensate accuracy. Framework support is not an exact negative dose/lag effect.
existingReviews.rdsReview: Driver endpoints; distinguish measurement/construct and shared task inputs, no RDS direct effect.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing record unchanged, legacy incomplete and no new executability. Source-family ownership retained; review is a proposal only.

existingReviews.rationale: External recommendation detail and internal action-plan specificity are distinct analytic units; uptake, comprehension and opportunity are required.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Reinwand examines selected intervention-arm plan writers, not randomized specificity-to-specificity transmission; COM-B is not exact manipulation evidence.
existingReviews.proposal: Require realized specified recommendation exposure, internal plan measurement, independent comparator, uptake and temporal scope; no existing replacement implemented.
existingReviews.rdsReview: Driver endpoints; distinguish measurement/construct and shared task inputs, no RDS direct effect.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing record unchanged, legacy incomplete and no new executability. Source-family ownership retained; review is a proposal only.

existingReviews.rationale: Monitoring can change perceived-current information before corrective behavior. The RDS then recalculates; later progress toward a target is not the same operation. For a signed discrepancy, approach to zero is not universal NEGATIVE polarity.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Harkin assesses monitoring and goal attainment, not a universal decrease in signed perceived discrepancy. Shared current/reference inputs and feedback can increase a revealed gap.
existingReviews.proposal: Separate research questions for perception/input updating and later corrective behavior under explicit reference, sign and interval; no causal replacement or formal pathway. Recalculate RDS only, without adding formula-as-causality.
existingReviews.rdsReview: PSY-078 required external reference/current inputs; signed DIFFERENCE. No causal input merely from recalculation; no exogenous source or outgoing claim.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing record unchanged, legacy incomplete and no new executability. Source-family ownership retained; review is a proposal only.

existingReviews.rationale: BFI-2 construct validation and Big Five academic-performance prediction do not directly test conscientiousness causing monitoring intensity.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Between-person trait association, shared reporting and outcome mismatch; monitoring may depend on goals, feedback and opportunity independently.
existingReviews.rdsReview: Driver endpoints; distinguish measurement/construct and shared task inputs, no RDS direct effect.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing record unchanged, legacy incomplete and no new executability. Source-family ownership retained; review is a proposal only.

existingReviews.rationale: Visible tracking is an affordance; deliberate attended comparison is the Psychological target. NIST AI RMF is not exact behavioral efficacy evidence.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Passive collection, dashboard visibility and realized checking differ. Monitoring-intervention synthesis cannot isolate a particular platform visibility change.
existingReviews.proposal: Scope to specified visible data, verified attention/comparison, person-level monitoring and temporal comparator; identify exact causal evidence before review. Do not infer efficacy from a framework.
existingReviews.rdsReview: Driver endpoints; distinguish measurement/construct and shared task inputs, no RDS direct effect.
existingReviews.executionReview: Existing record unchanged, legacy incomplete and no new executability. Source-family ownership retained; review is a proposal only.

hypotheses.question: Prompts to check and record progress increase PSY-077.
hypotheses.reason: EA0016 retains synthesis support for monitoring frequency but exact reusable prompt protocol/attention alignment unresolved.

hypotheses.question: Monitoring necessarily decreases signed goal discrepancy.
hypotheses.reason: Revealed information may increase gap; approach to zero can increase a negative value. Formula updating is not independent causal propagation.

hypotheses.question: Desired/reference and perceived current inputs derive PSY-078.
hypotheses.reason: Already encoded required external inputs. No invented constituent Driver or duplicate binary edge; scenario specification remains needed.

hypotheses.question: Monitoring → discrepancy → goal attainment is a causal pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Meta-analytic mediation and theory do not identify transmitted pathway with exact RDS scope, timing and endpoints.

hypotheses.question: Forming if-then plan increases implementation intention strength.
hypotheses.reason: Reuse HT0014 only; manipulation assignment/plan production not strength or commitment measurement.

hypotheses.question: Implementation intention equals action.
hypotheses.reason: Plans and realized behavior differ; engaged gym participants still showed no positive attendance effect.

hypotheses.question: Guided external recommendations produce more specific internal plans.
hypotheses.reason: Existing INF-043 revision path; intervention-arm selected plan writers do not isolate causal transmission.

hypotheses.question: Low negative expectancies associate with more specific plans.
hypotheses.reason: Reinwand selected uptake and action-plan coding require exact PSY-004 outcome-probability alignment; no formal new association.

hypotheses.question: Specificity automatically proves instrumentality or feasibility.
hypotheses.reason: What/when/where/how content can be specific yet infeasible; content quality dimensions differ.

hypotheses.question: Affect-regulation training raises PSY-079 capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Multi-skill package and past-week composite, not momentary whole capacity; waitlist and active controls differ.

hypotheses.question: ART proves any single reappraisal component improves capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Package effect cannot be assigned to a component; no fidelity/strategy isolate.

hypotheses.question: Emotion skills mediate training effect on depression.
hypotheses.reason: Postrandomization mediator and outcome share reports; intervention randomization does not randomize mediator.

hypotheses.question: Emotion regulation capacity equals reappraisal preference.
hypotheses.reason: Current ability differs from habitual strategy use and goals; regulation may increase an emotion.

hypotheses.question: Repeated GNG practice increases response inhibition capacity.
hypotheses.reason: EA0017 RN due go-speed/transfer proxies, protocol heterogeneity and active-control results.

hypotheses.question: Faster go responses prove stronger inhibition.
hypotheses.reason: Response initiation speed is not stopping/withholding; training can favor go trials.

hypotheses.question: Food intake reduction proves general self-control capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Stimulus devaluation, learned cue association and task-specific withholding are alternatives to broad capacity.

hypotheses.question: Prior exertion depletes current self-control capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Preserve small positive Stroop-antisaccade replication and confirmatory multisite nondetection, not a universal resource model.

hypotheses.question: A depletion-task effect proves a finite physiological self-control resource.
hypotheses.reason: Task-sequence effect cannot identify latent substrate; fatigue, motivation, strategy and expectations remain alternatives.

hypotheses.question: Sleep loss reduces response inhibition.
hypotheses.reason: Healthy GNG/SST synthesis supports bounded impairment, but exact canonical BIO source/protocol and capacity measurement need reconciliation; reuse existing sleep-loss HT, no BIO-F01 work.

hypotheses.question: Attentional control, inhibition and working-memory availability are identical.
hypotheses.reason: Related tasks/processes are not semantic identity; interference suppression differs from stopping initiated action.

hypotheses.question: Motivation moderates exact BIO-019 fatigue-control effect.
hypotheses.reason: Theory and measured fatigue moderators are not independent exact-edge causal evidence.

hypotheses.question: Coping training changes PSY-083.
hypotheses.reason: Chinese workplace packages and self-report scores need exact capacity and active-comparator followup; no component efficacy.

hypotheses.question: Coping flexibility equals coping repertoire or cognitive flexibility.
hypotheses.reason: Fit, repertoire, switching and perceived ability differ in definition and association magnitude.

hypotheses.question: Cultural individualism changes coping-flexibility benefits.
hypotheses.reason: Country-level meta-moderator is observational/ecological, not exact cultural Driver or governed edge interaction.

hypotheses.question: Social support increases usable self-control or coping capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Social contact/context plausible; no sufficiently aligned randomized exact Driver contrast extracted here.

hypotheses.question: Noise/environmental disruption lowers attentional control.
hypotheses.reason: Reuse F06 noise synthesis; broad cognitive performance is not current PSY-080, task-specific direction remains.

hypotheses.question: Institutional schedules or rules improve planning/monitoring.
hypotheses.reason: Opportunity and compliance requirements are not internal uptake; selected training studies do not isolate policy effect.

hypotheses.question: A platform tracking occurrence proves self-monitoring.
hypotheses.reason: Data availability, access and attended comparison are separate. No occurrence-to-consequence shortcut.

hypotheses.question: One short training permanently improves conscientiousness.
hypotheses.reason: Current state versus stable disposition/time scale; no trait change identified.
